set.body: Trace and implement the real automatic pair workflow for CoherentHeaderWorldIdentityThenCapture: prepare common physical capture inputs, run bounded structural capture, compare retained candidates through the frozen projected-patch objective, refine the selected candidate, and return canonical output with capture diagnostics and costs. Opened L23 fixtures are development evidence only; fresh sealed accuracy and refreshed cost evidence remain subsequent admission work.
